items.title: China y EEUU se interesan por proyectos mineros en Perú mientras gobierno urge elevar producción
items.author: Marco Aquino
items.creator: Marco Aquino
items.summary: Perú espera elevar su producción anual de cobre en un millón de toneladas en cinco a seis años con nuevos proyectos, mientras empresas chinas y estadounidenses evalúan inversiones en medio de una mayor competencia por minerales críticos en Sudamérica, dijo a Reuters el ministro de Energía y Minas, Guillermo Shinno.
items.body:
Perú espera elevar su producción anual de cobre en un millón de toneladas en cinco a seis años con nuevos proyectos, mientras empresas chinas y estadounidenses evalúan inversiones en medio de una mayor competencia por minerales críticos en Sudamérica, dijo a Reuters el ministro de Energía y Minas, Guillermo Shinno.
El país andino, el tercer mayor productor mundial de cobre, espera que su producción se mantenga este año en entre 2,5 y 2,7 millones de toneladas, prácticamente sin cambios desde el 2023 por la disminución de la ley del mineral, y en medio de recurrentes conflictos sociales, dijo el titular de la cartera.
Shinno señaló que el gobierno de la presidenta Keiko Fujimori, que asumio a fines de julio, busca revertir este estancamiento simplificando los trámites burocráticos.
En los últimos dos meses una veintena de empresas mineras han mostrado interés en desempolvar proyectos, dijo. Entre ellas de China, que compra el 73% del cobre que produce Perú; y de Estados Unidos, en momentos en que Washington busca expandir su presencia en las cadenas de suministro de minerales críticos.
"Las expectativas son enormes, todos han estado preguntando y viniendo al ministerio para ver cómo pueden implementar sus proyectos", afirmó Shinno en una entrevista la noche del jueves.
El ministro dijo que el Gobierno está comprometido en reducir el centenar de trámites en el sector, para atraer inversión. "Se ha identificado que podríamos eliminar 27 permisos", dijo Shinno. "No se trata de relajar el estándar ambiental, sino ser rigurosos y muy claros".
Alrededor del 70% de los 64.000 millones de dólares de la cartera de proyectos mineros está vinculado al cobre, agregó.
El ministro señaló que casi toda la inversión comprometida para este año, que sumarían unos 7.000 millones de dólares, son solo para fortalecer operaciones o para extender la vida de las minas. "Con nuevos proyectos previstos, en 5 o 6 años podríamos agregar un millón de toneladas de cobre mas por año", dijo.
La minería es clave para la economía local porque sus ventas representan el 70% de las exportaciones totales del país.
POTENCIALES PLANES Entre las firmas que se han acercado al despacho de Shinno, según registros del ministerio, figuran las chinas Las Bambas de MMG, Chinalco, Shougang y Jinzhao; las estadounidenses Newmont (NEM.N) y Freeport-McMoRan (FCX.N) , además de las globales First Quantum (FM.TO) , Barrick (ABX.TO) , Anglo American (AAL.L) y Glencore (GLEN.L) .
El ministro dijo que First Quantum quiere avanzar con su proyecto de cobre La Granja, mientras que Chinalco adquirió en julio el proyecto Los Calatos, en el sur del país, y actualmente está realizando estudios ambientales previos a su desarrollo.
First Quantum informó en un comunicado en mayo que actualizó los recursos en La Granja y describió al proyecto "como el segundo mayor recurso de cobre virgen del mundo".
El Gobierno estima inversiones de 2.400 millones de dólares en La Granja y 655 millones de dólares en Los Calatos en los próximos años. Chinalco, que opera la mina Toromocho, y Las Bambas están entre las seis minas de cobre más grandes del Perú.
Shinno afirmó que prevé asimismo una mayor inversión minera estadounidense mientras Washington busca reducir la influencia china en los minerales estratégicos. Estados Unidos y Perú firmaron en febrero un acuerdo de cooperación en minerales críticos, que el secretario de Estado estadounidense, Marco Rubio, destacó durante su visita a Lima en septiembre como una forma de aprovechar las nuevas oportunidades en el sector.
"Todos aquellos que quieren invertir responsablemente y respetar las leyes peruanas son bienvenidos. No hay un trato discriminatorio. Esperemos que con esta nueva política que tiene Estados Unidos más empresas americanas se animen a venir", dijo Shinno.
La estadounidense Freeport-McMoRan planea extender hasta el 2053 la vida de su mina de cobre en Perú, con una inversión de 2.100 millones de dólares, según el ministerio peruano.
items.raw_description: Perú espera elevar su producción anual de cobre en un millón de toneladas en cinco a seis años con nuevos proyectos, mientras empresas chinas y estadounidenses evalúan inversiones en medio de una mayor competencia por minerales críticos en Sudamérica, dijo a Reuters el ministro de Energía y Minas, Guillermo Shinno.

items.title: Chinese, US firms line up for Peru copper projects as government cuts red tape
items.author: Marco Aquino
items.creator: Marco Aquino
items.summary: Peru expects to boost annual copper production by about 1 million metric tons within 5 to 6 years through new mining projects, as Chinese and US companies weigh investments amid broader competition for critical minerals in South America, Peru's Energy and Mines Minister told Reuters.
items.body:
Peru expects to boost annual copper production by about 1 million metric tons within 5 to 6 years through new [USN:L6N43H166 TEXT:"mining projects"], as Chinese and US companies weigh investments amid broader competition for critical minerals in South America, Peru's Energy and Mines Minister told Reuters.
Peru, the world's third-largest copper producer, expects output to remain between 2.5 million and 2.7 million tons this year, roughly unchanged from 2023 due to declining ore grades and recurring social conflicts, Minister Guillermo Shinno said.
The newly elected conservative government of [USN:L6N43Q0ZQ TEXT:"President Keiko Fujimori"] is seeking to reverse that [USN:L1N3WU0PV TEXT:"stagnation"] by cutting red tape.
In the two months since the Fujimori administration took office, mining companies have stepped up engagement with the ministry as they seek to revive stalled projects, Shinno said. Companies including from China , Peru's largest copper customer, and from the US as [USN:S0N42V05J TEXT:"Washington"] seeks to expand its footprint in critical mineral supply chains, have expressed interest.
"Expectations are enormous. Everyone has been asking questions and coming to the ministry to see how they can move forward with their projects," Shinno said in an interview with Reuters late on Thursday.
CUTTING BACK SOME REQUIREMENTS The minister said the government was committed to reducing roughly 100 permitting requirements across the mining sector to attract investment.
"We have identified 27 permits that could be eliminated," the minister said. "This is not about lowering environmental standards, but about being rigorous and very clear."
About 70% of Peru's $64 billion mining project pipeline is tied to copper, Shinno added.
Most of the roughly $7 billion in mining investment expected in 2026 is aimed at sustaining operations or extending mine life, rather than adding significant new output.
"With the new projects we have planned, in five or six years we could add another million tons of copper production per year," Shinno said.
CHINESE, US FIRMS EYE PROJECTS Among roughly 20 companies that have met with the new administration are Chinese firms such as MMG (1208.HK) , which owns [USN:L6N44G16H TEXT:"Las Bambas"], Chinalco, Shougang and Jinzhao, US-based miners Newmont (NEM.N) and Freeport-McMoRan FCX.N and global mining companies First Quantum (FM.TO) , Barrick (ABX.TO) , Anglo American (AAL.L) and Glencore (GLEN.L) , ministry records show.
Shinno said First Quantum wants to advance its La Granja copper project, while Chinalco in July acquired the Los Calatos project in southern Peru, which is undergoing environmental studies ahead of development.
First Quantum representatives in Lima did not immediately respond to a request for comment.
The government estimates investments of $2.4 billion for La Granja and $655 million for Los Calatos in the coming years. The Toromocho mine, operated by [USN:L1N3YU1NA TEXT:"Chinalco"], and Las Bambas are among Peru's 6 largest copper mines.
Shinno said he also expects greater US mining investment as Washington seeks to counter Chinese influence in strategic minerals. The US and Peru signed a critical minerals cooperation agreement in February, which US Secretary of State Marco Rubio highlighted during a [USN:L1N4520UP TEXT:"visit to Peru"] this month as a way to capitalize on new opportunities in the sector.
"We hope that more American companies will be encouraged to come," Shinno added.

items.title: Data centre IPO hopefuls brave tougher market as investor scrutiny grows
items.author: Reuters Staff
items.summary: Data centre operator DayOne is pushing ahead with its plans to go public as soon as November, according to three people familiar with the matter, even as higher interest rates and setbacks elsewhere ...
items.body: Data centre operator DayOne is pushing ahead with its plans to go public as soon as November, according to three people familiar with the matter, even as higher interest rates and setbacks elsewhere in the data centre ecosystem threaten to narrow the window for companies to tap the IPO market. The Singapore-based company develops and operates data centres for cloud and AI customers. It plans to make its filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission public in mid-October and list in November, the people said, speaking anonymously to discuss confidential matters. The plans, including the timing of the IPO, are subject to change, the people cautioned. DayOne declined to comment. DayOne’s IPO intentions follow two setbacks for data centre operators this week: the delay of SB Energy’s expected IPO and news of a dispute centering on Oracle and Blue Owl that could delay a data centre project in New Mexico. The contrast highlights how the market for AI infrastructure is maturing after years of strong investor enthusiasm. Companies with diversified customers and greater visibility into demand can still attract interest, while projects that rely heavily on a single AI customer or require large amounts of capital upfront face greater scrutiny. “The dividing line is whether demand is contracted and already energized, or only planned,” said Ke Yan, head of research at Singapore-based investment research firm Shenton Research. With power now the key constraint, investors favor operators with secured power supply, a large share of contracted capacity already operating or nearing completion, and long-dated take-or-pay contracts, he said. Investor scrutiny is intensifying as a growing pipeline of companies head toward the public markets, with data centre developers and operators including Switch, Vantage Data Centers and CyrusOne exploring or preparing IPOs. Switch has filed confidentially for an IPO, and is expected to launch its offering following DayOne, one of the people said. Switch did not respond to a request for comments. A more diversified offering DayOne’s geographic diversification and the fact it has operational data centers, not just ones under development, have helped distinguish it from some rivals in the eyes of investors, one of the people said. The company, backed by investors like Coatue and Hillhouse, raised US$4.5 billion in a Series C funding round that closed in June. It could seek to raise as much as $5 billion in the IPO at a valuation of about $20 billion, Reuters has reported. It has secured about 2.1 gigawatts of capacity bookings and operates across Asia-Pacific and Europe, including Malaysia, Hong Kong, Japan, Finland and Spain, according to its website. Meanwhile, SoftBank-backed SB Energy has postponed plans to formally market its IPO this week as it works to address additional questions from the US Securities and Exchange Commission. There are also investor concerns over the valuation it is seeking and its reliance on OpenAI as a major customer, one of the three people familiar with the matter and another person said. Discussions around the IPO have centered on a valuation of about $60 billion, one of the people added. SB Energy declined to comment. There have been various dealings between SoftBank, SB Energy, its main data centre customer OpenAI and OpenAI’s chip supplier Nvidia in recent months. Nvidia has agreed to provide a guarantee of up to $105 billion to help OpenAI lease the Ohio data centre being developed by SB Energy, while also investing $1.5 billion in SB Energy. OpenAI backer SoftBank is taking investor orders for a $10 billion dollar-denominated debt deal to help fund its OpenAI investments. The company previously took a loan backed by the OpenAI stake. AI spending faces closer scrutiny The cost of financing the AI buildout is coming under greater pressure. AI-related capital spending by the six biggest U.S. technology companies is projected to reach around $1 trillion in 2027, according to Moody’s. Higher interest rates make it more expensive to finance facilities whose returns may take years to materialize, while investors are demanding greater visibility into the customers and cash flows that will support those investments. For developers relying on debt, contracted revenue from creditworthy customers is crucial to servicing that debt as they fund costly AI-ready facilities, including high-density racks and liquid-cooling systems, said Neil Bear-Hetherington, director of data centre capital markets, Asia Pacific, at CBRE. For data centre developers, that makes the identity and financial strength of their customers increasingly important to investors evaluating projects that can require billions of dollars of upfront investment. For companies preparing to go public, a less forgiving IPO market and greater scrutiny of AI infrastructure create an incentive to move quickly while investor demand is available. “The earlier the better. Uncertainty is what hurts data-centre models. Investors in data centres are looking for yield and growth together, and uncertainty weighs on both, since it raises the cost of the debt that supports the yield and delays the grid and financing that growth depends on,” said Yan of Shenton Research. (Reporting by Echo Wang in New York and Yantoultra Ngui in Hong Kong; Additional reporting by Milana Vinn in New York and Kane Wu in Hong Kong; Editing by Colin Barr and Nia Williams)

items.title: 米カンザスシティー連銀総裁、インフレ問題に十分対処できていない
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米カンザスシティー連銀のシュミッド総裁は25日、物価上昇率が米金融当局の目標である2%を上回っており、政策当局はインフレ問題にまだ十分対処できていないとの認識を示した。

シュミッド総裁はカンザスシティーでの討論会で「インフレ問題はまだ解決できていない」と述べ、「インフレ率が目標を上回る状態が5年以上続いている」と指摘した。

さらに、政策当局者は株式市場のバリュエーションや経済の動向を注視しているものの、個別の動きを細かく追い過ぎることはないと述べた。

シュミッド総裁は「AIやデータセンターの建設拡大で何が起きているのかをしっかり把握する必要がある。われわれは『大き過ぎてつぶせない』AIエコシステムに向かっているのか」と発言。「われわれがデータを通じて見極めようとしているのはそこだと思う。システム全体に関わる問題が何かあるのかということだ」と述べた。

同総裁は今年、金融政策決定で議決権を持たないが、政策金利の誘導目標を3.75－4%に引き上げた今月の利上げを支持したとこれまでに述べている。

items.title: Russia says it struck Ukrainian defence industry facilities, vessels
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The Russian defence ministry said on Friday its forces had carried out overnight drone strikes on Ukrainian defence industry facilities, logistics centres and vessels used by Ukraine's armed forces.
items.body:
The Russian defence ministry said on Friday its forces had carried out overnight drone strikes on Ukrainian defence industry facilities, logistics centres and vessels used by Ukraine's armed forces.
The ministry said the strikes hit a drone assembly and storage site in the Kyiv region, logistics hubs in the Odesa region and port infrastructure in Reni on the Danube River.
It also said Russian forces struck a cargo ship carrying military and dual-use goods to the port of Odesa.
The ministry said later on Friday that its forces had struck another cargo vessel in the Odesa region that delivered military supplies to the port of Chornomorsk, a logistics centre used by Ukraine's military and security forces, and a data centre used for processing and transmission of intelligence data.
Reuters could not independently verify the statements.

items.title: US Senate approves legislation to address pilot, air traffic control mental health issues
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: The US Senate approved bipartisan legislation to modernize regulations on mental health guidance for pilots and air traffic controllers to encourage early disclosure and treatment.
items.body:
The US Senate approved bipartisan legislation to modernize regulations on mental health guidance for pilots and air traffic controllers to encourage early disclosure and treatment.
Commercial airline pilots often conceal mental health conditions for fear that disclosing therapy or medication, or even just seeking help, could mean having their license pulled, putting themselves and their passengers at risk.
The issue drew new attention after an off-duty Alaska Airlines (ALK.N) pilot in late 2023 was charged with trying to disable the engines of a jet in flight and told police afterward he was suffering a nervous breakdown.
The legislation, sponsored by Senators John Hoeven and Tammy Duckworth, was approved unanimously late Thursday and aims to encourage pilots and air traffic controllers to seek mental health care, when needed, while reducing the stigma.
A separate bill also passed by the Senate requires the FAA to issue accessible, user-friendly guidance on approved medications to ensure pilots or controllers these individuals don't unknowingly take medications that could put their careers in jeopardy.
"Their careers should never be threatened because they weren't properly informed about which medications they're allowed to take, or simply sought the mental health care they need," said Duckworth, a Democrat, adding lawmakers aim to "dismantle the dangerous culture of silence surrounding mental health in the aviation industry and ultimately make our skies safer."
Pilots face strict rules around medication and can be forced to stop flying for three months if they change antidepressant or anxiety drug dosage levels or medications for mental health issues.
Hoeven, a Republican, noted the significant shortage of qualified pilots and air traffic controllers, adding "bureaucratic delays and outdated processes at the FAA keep these professionals from working for prolonged periods when they seek mental health care."
The Allied Pilots Association, which represents 17,000 pilots at American Airlines (AAL.O) , praised passage of the bills saying they represent meaningful progress toward modernizing the FAA’s approach to pilot mental health.
"For far too long, pilots have faced barriers to seeking care and navigating the medical certification process," APA President Nick Silva said.
The FAA which did not immediately comment Friday, convened an expert panel in late 2023 to make recommendations on pilot mental health issues and "to help break down barriers that prevent pilots and air traffic controllers from reporting mental health issues." The report found that about 20% of pilots and controllers who report a mental health issue are initially disqualified from work and it can take more than a year to get approval to use an antidepressant medication.

items.title: Na França, papa Leão 14 alerta que ONU corre risco de se tornar uma “farsa”
items.author: Joshua McElwee, Elizabeth Pineau
items.creator: Joshua McElwee, Elizabeth Pineau
items.summary: O papa Leão 14 afirmou na sexta-feira que as Nações Unidas e outros organismos multilaterais estão em crise, alertando, em um discurso na sede da Unesco, órgão da ONU para a cultura e a educação, em Paris, que o diálogo internacional corre o risco de se tornar uma “farsa”.
items.body:
O papa Leão 14 afirmou na sexta-feira que as Nações Unidas e outros organismos multilaterais estão em crise, alertando, em um discurso na sede da Unesco, órgão da ONU para a cultura e a educação, em Paris, que o diálogo internacional corre o risco de se tornar uma “farsa”.
O primeiro papa norte-americano, falando durante uma visita à França enquanto uma tensa Assembleia Geral da ONU se desenrola em Nova York, também criticou os líderes mundiais que desrespeitam o Estado de Direito, sem citar nomes.
“Em vez de respeitar a lei, aqueles que estão no poder a invocam quando lhes convém e a desconsideram quando lhes impõe restrições, tratando até mesmo a própria justiça como se fosse uma mercadoria a ser comprada e vendida”, disse o pontífice.
A ONU e outros grupos multilaterais “estão passando por uma crise de eficácia”, afirmou ele. “O diálogo é visto como um obstáculo à ação, em vez de um recurso para a paz; uma farsa, em vez de uma oportunidade de buscar juntos o bem comum.”
Leão, que se tornou papa em maio de 2025, despertou a ira do presidente dos EUA, Donald Trump, no início do ano, após criticar a guerra contra o Irã.
A Assembleia Geral da ONU deste ano, que termina na segunda-feira, tem sido palco de discussões acaloradas. Em um discurso na terça-feira, Trump ameaçou aniquilar o Irã caso o país não concorde com os termos para encerrar a guerra. Na quinta-feira, dezenas de delegados deixaram o plenário enquanto o primeiro-ministro israelense, Benjamin Netanyahu, discursava.
Trump anunciou em 2025 que os EUA se retirariam da Unesco.
Leão está em uma visita a três cidades da França, onde busca restaurar a reputação da Igreja após escândalos de abuso que causaram comoção em todo o país.
PAPA ALERTA PARA RISCOS DA IA O papa, que fez do alerta sobre os riscos da IA uma parte central de seu papado de 16 meses, colocou a questão no centro de sua visita à França, a primeira de um papa em quase 20 anos.
Na manhã desta sexta-feira, ele exortou o mundo a reconsiderar o desenvolvimento da inteligência artificial, alertando em um discurso aos líderes franceses que a IA poderia criar um futuro em que “um paraíso das máquinas” assumisse o controle da Terra.
“Se quisermos evitar perder nossa humanidade em meio a um ‘paraíso das máquinas’ que invade e condiciona nossa vida cotidiana, há uma necessidade urgente de educação em discernimento ético”, disse ele, falando sob os tetos dourados do Palácio do Eliseu.
MENSAGEM DE PAZ Leão foi recebido no aeroporto de Orly, em Paris, sob um céu azul límpido, pelo presidente Emmanuel Macron e sua esposa Brigitte, além de crianças que cantaram para ele e pediram autógrafos. Durante sua visita de quatro dias, ele viajará ao famoso santuário católico de Lourdes, no sudoeste, e a Metz, na fronteira com a Alemanha.
Ao dizer aos repórteres no avião a caminho de Paris que vinha para transmitir uma mensagem de paz, Leão acrescentou: “É uma mensagem que, neste momento, como todos sabemos, é particularmente importante.”
A França, uma nação secular onde a separação entre Igreja e Estado está consagrada em uma lei de 1905, tem testemunhado um declínio constante na filiação à Igreja Católica durante o período do pós-guerra, refletindo uma tendência observada em outros países tradicionalmente católicos.

items.title: La ONU amplía la lista de empresas vinculadas a los asentamientos israelíes
items.author: Emma Farge
items.creator: Emma Farge
items.summary: La Oficina de Derechos Humanos de Naciones Unidas publicó el viernes una lista en la que se añaden 61 empresas más que operan en los asentamientos israelíes de Cisjordania, que este organismo internacional considera ilegales.
items.body:
La Oficina de Derechos Humanos de Naciones Unidas publicó el viernes una lista en la que se añaden 61 empresas más que operan en los asentamientos israelíes de Cisjordania, que este organismo internacional considera ilegales.
La base de datos es un asunto muy delicado, ya que las empresas podrían ser objeto de boicots o desinversiones para presionar a Israel por la expansión de los asentamientos en el territorio, donde viven más de tres millones de palestinos.
La base de datos, publicada por primera vez en 2020, incluye ahora 214 empresas, en su mayoría de Israel, pero también de otros 10 países, entre ellos Francia, Alemania, China y Estados Unidos.
Entre las empresas recién añadidas se encuentran el fabricante israelí de pesticidas ADAMA, que forma parte del grupo chino Syngenta, la sociedad de inversión inmobiliaria con sede en Israel Alony Hetz y la española Salvat Logística.
Se suman así a empresas como la agencia de viajes Expedia y la plataforma de alquiler de viviendas Airbnb, que ya figuraban en la lista.
Israel, que considera que Cisjordania es un territorio en disputa y no ocupado, ha afirmado anteriormente que la lista difama de forma injusta a las empresas que operan legalmente.
"Se trata de un mecanismo sesgado, creado por un organismo profundamente defectuoso con una mayoría automática en contra de Israel", dijo el viernes la misión diplomática israelí, alegando que la base de datos se creó para "perseguir" al Estado judío.
Se ha producido un aumento de los ataques de los colonos contra los palestinos a medida que proliferan los asentamientos, lo que ha llevado a Reino Unido, Francia y Canadá a bloquear este mes las importaciones procedentes de los asentamientos.

items.title: Prestigioso premio Goncourt de Francia retira novela tras acusaciones de uso de IA contra su autor
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: Los organizadores del prestigioso premio literario Goncourt anunciaron el viernes la retirada de su lista preliminar una novela de gran éxito del autor haitiano-canadiense Thelyson Orelien, tras las acusaciones de que recurrió a la inteligencia artificial para escribirla.
items.body:
Los organizadores del prestigioso premio literario Goncourt anunciaron el viernes la retirada de su lista preliminar una novela de gran éxito del autor haitiano-canadiense Thelyson Orelien, tras las acusaciones de que recurrió a la inteligencia artificial para escribirla.
Orelien negó haber utilizado IA para escribir "C'était ça ou mourir" ("Era eso o morir"), mientras las acusaciones desencadenaban un debate sobre raza, mérito literario y originalidad que ha agitado al establishment literario francés.
Las acusaciones sobre el uso de la IA las lanzó esta semana una cuenta poco conocida de la red social X llamada "Balance ton Claude". El ensayista Samuel Fitoussi reivindicó más tarde la autoría de la cuenta, afirmando que la gestionaba junto con otras personas no identificadas.
A las acusaciones sobre la IA les siguieron informes que apuntaban a que Orelien había cometido plagio en obras anteriores. La Presse señaló que un relato corto de Orelien de 2012 había plagiado pasajes de un libro del autor francés Louis Pauwels, mientras que un artículo de opinión de 2013 copiaba del periódico The Philippine Star.
Orelien aún no ha respondido a esas acusaciones y no contestó a una solicitud de comentarios el viernes.
La Academia Goncourt, con sede en París, declaró que había tomado nota de las acusaciones de uso de IA y de plagio, y que había decidido retirar su novela "para preservar la integridad del Premio Goncourt y la de la Academia, cuya función principal es promover y honrar la literatura escrita por mujeres y hombres".
La Academia afirmó que espera que su decisión muestre su total oposición a la "creación de textos generados con la ayuda de la IA" y añadió que no hará más comentarios hasta el 6 de octubre, fecha en la que anunciará su lista de finalistas.
La primera novela del autor, nacido en Haití, narra la historia de un migrante haitiano que viaja hacia el norte a través de América Latina antes de llegar a Canadá. La obra ha ganado numerosos premios literarios y estaba previsto que se tradujera a varios idiomas.
Sus editoriales francesa y canadiense ofrecieron inicialmente a Orelien todo su apoyo ante las acusaciones relacionadas con la IA. El viernes no respondieron a las solicitudes de comentarios.
Balance ton Claude afirmó que al pasar fragmentos de la novela por la herramienta de detección de IA Pangram se observó que la novela 2había sido escrita casi en su totalidad por inteligencia artificial". Algunos expertos señalan que la fiabilidad de las herramientas de detección de IA es cuestionable.

items.title: Canada's budget deficit over first four months of 2026/27 slightly falls to C$5.14 billion
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: OTTAWA, Sept 25 (Reuters) - Canada recorded a slightly lower C$5.14 billion ($3.63 billion) budget deficit for the first four months of the 2026/27 fiscal year as government revenues grew faster than expenditures, the finance ministry said on Friday.
items.body:
OTTAWA, Sept 25 (Reuters) - Canada recorded a slightly lower C$5.14 billion ($3.63 billion) budget deficit for the first four months of the 2026/27 fiscal year as government revenues grew faster than expenditures, the finance ministry said on Friday.
By comparison, the deficit in the same period a year earlier had been C$7.79 billion, it said in a statement.
Revenues over the four-month period increased by 7.4% largely reflecting higher income from personal and corporate income tax revenues. Expenses grew by 5.1%, driven by transfers for Old Age Security, increased operating costs and other transfer payments.
Public debt charges increased by 7.4%, largely reflecting higher average effective interest rates on an increased stock of marketable bonds, the ministry said.
On a monthly basis, Canada's deficit increased sharply to C$4.77 billion in July, compared to a C$1.51 billion deficit in July 2025.
($1 = 1.4146 Canadian dollars)
(Reporting by Promit Mukherjee, editing by David Ljunggren)
((Reuters Ottawa bureau; david.ljunggren@tr.com ))

items.title: US Federal Reserve plans to raise bank oversight thresholds, sources say
items.author: Reuters
items.summary: The US Federal Reserve is set to propose an increase in the asset thresholds for banking regulations, potentially raising the current $700 billion limit to around $960 billion. This adjustment could benefit lenders by reducing compliance costs and easing regulatory burdens for banks near the threshold. However, analysts caution that such changes may spur consolidation among mid-sized banks, which could undermine competition and elevate systemic risks in the financial sector.
items.body: The US Federal Reserve is working on a plan to raise the asset thresholds that trigger stricter oversight of big banks, four people with knowledge of the matter said, which would allow some lenders to avoid costly additional regulation and potentially spur consolidation.The central bank is expected to soon propose reindexing the thresholds where banks become subject to stress tests of their balance sheets, liquidity, capital and other more stringent rules, to account for inflation and economic growth, the people said. Three of the people said they expect the Fed to propose the changes later this year.Current rules impose stricter requirements when a bank reaches $100 billion in assets, stepping up at $250 billion and again at $700 billion. Lenders say those thresholds, set in 2019, haven't kept pace with the economy, subjecting banks to increasingly stringent oversight that exceeds the risks they pose.Banks say crossing the $100 billion threshold typically requires major investment in compliance staff, risk management systems, stress-testing capabilities and regulatory reporting infrastructure that can run into tens of millions of dollars annually.The Fed is considering reindexing the highest threshold closer to $1 trillion and some of the requirements triggered by the lower threshold closer to $150 billion, said the people, who declined to be named as they were discussing sensitive regulatory issues.Banks that stand to benefit include U.S. Bancorp, Capital One, PNC Financial and Truist, which are closest to the $700 billion threshold, giving them more room to grow without incurring some of the toughest Fed oversight, including aspects of new incoming capital rules and daily reporting requirements to supervisors.Western Alliance, Zions and several others, meanwhile, could grow beyond $100 billion without incurring all the requirements currently imposed on lenders in that category. Pinnacle Financial Partners and one or two other lenders sitting between $100 billion and $150 billion could even shed some requirements.A Fed spokesperson declined to comment. In January, Fed Vice Chair for Supervision Michelle Bowman said the central bank would consider reindexing the thresholds and suggested using nominal GDP, but the Fed has not commented since then. The US economy has grown significantly over the past seven years, and it makes sense to have rules for all banks that will help consumers and small businesses through increased bank lending capacity and more competition, a U.S. Bancorp spokesperson said.The other banks either declined to comment or did not respond to requests for comment.CHANGES COULD SPUR MID-SIZE BANK DEALSThe plan is part of a broader effort by the Trump administration to reform bank oversight which officials say is stifling lending and the economy. Bowman is also overhauling capital rules and other aspects of the Fed's supervisory regime.The changes could lead consolidation among mid-size lenders which have been holding off for fear of breaching the thresholds, the people said. Revised thresholds can reduce downsides of growth and change relative costs/benefits of acquisitions, analysts at Truist wrote on Friday in response to Reuters' story.Banks with $50 billion to $700 billion of assets announced just 33 bank and thrift acquisitions over the past decade, according to S&P Global Market Intelligence, with just seven such deals last year, including Fifth Third's $10.9 billion acquisition of Comerica. We would expect this to unlock M&A activity among mid-cap and regional banks that have been in a holding pattern, said James Stevens, partner at law firm Troutman Pepper Locke, adding bank boards would be able to assess deals on merit rather than on the regulatory math. One banking industry executive said raising the $700 billion threshold would allow larger lenders to more effectively compete with the country's four biggest consumer banks.Critics of bank consolidation argue it harms consumers by reducing competition and services, while increasing systemic risks.BANKS HAVE LONG ARGUED THRESHOLDS ARE ARBITRARYFollowing the US financial crisis, the 2010 Dodd-Frank Act set supervisory thresholds, which Congress softened in 2018. That law mandates some requirements that only Congress can change, including stress tests for banks in the $100 billion bucket and enhanced prudential standards for those above $250 billion.But the law also gave the Fed broad discretion, and the central bank imposed additional capital planning, liquidity and reporting requirements for the $100 billion category. It also created the $700 billion category to ensure sufficient oversight for big banks not deemed globally systemically important banks, which are subject to a separate regime.Banks have long said the thresholds are arbitrary and can distort business decisions by encouraging banks to stay below them.Reindexing using nominal GDP would incorporate inflation and economic growth. It could push the highest threshold to around $960 billion and the lower threshold for the additional Fed requirements to roughly $150 billion.Democrats say Congress already watered down the rules in 2018, and asset thresholds, though imperfect, offer a simple way to calibrate requirements.

items.title: Manchester City, culpable de todos menos uno de los 115 cargos por infracciones: medios
items.author: Lori Ewing
items.creator: Lori Ewing
items.summary: El Manchester City fue hallado culpable de todas menos una de las 115 presuntas infracciones de las normas financieras de la Premier League, informaron el viernes The Athletic y The Times.
items.body:
El Manchester City fue hallado culpable de todas menos una de las 115 presuntas infracciones de las normas financieras de la Premier League, informaron el viernes The Athletic y The Times.
Según añaden los medios, se espera que el club presente un recurso.
La Premier declinó hacer declaraciones al respecto. "Se trata de un proceso confidencial, no vamos a hacer ningún comentario", indicó un portavoz.
El City no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios de Reuters, pero declaró a la BBC que la investigación sobre las acusaciones "sigue en curso".
La Premier remitió al City a una comisión independiente en febrero de 2023 por presuntas infracciones de las normas financieras que abarcan las temporadas 2009-10 a 2022-23. El club ha negado sistemáticamente haber cometido irregularidades.
Entre las acusaciones más graves estaba que el City no había facilitado en ninguna de las temporadas comprendidas entre 2009-10 y 2017-18 información financiera precisa que ofreciera una "imagen fiel" de los ingresos, incluidos los ingresos por patrocinios, y los costos operativos.
El City contrató al abogado David Pannick para que dirigiera su defensa, mientras que la Premier estuvo representada por Adam Lewis KC, según los medios británicos.
La vista comenzó el 16 de septiembre de 2024 y concluyó casi tres meses después, el 6 de diciembre. El caso fue juzgado por una comisión independiente compuesta por tres jueces designados por el presidente independiente del panel judicial de la Premier League.
El City fue sancionado con dos años de inhabilitación para participar en la Liga de Campeones por la UEFA, el organismo rector del fútbol europeo, en 2020, tras constatarse que había sobrevalorado sus ingresos por patrocinios entre 2012 y 2016.
Sin embargo, el club recurrió con éxito ante el Tribunal de Arbitraje Deportivo (TAS), que anuló la sanción.
Desde que el Abu Dhabi United Group del jeque Mansour compró el club en 2008, el City ha ganado ocho títulos de la Premier League, la Liga de Campeones, cuatro Copas de Inglaterra y siete Copas de la Liga.
El City lidera la Premier esta temporada tras ganar sus cinco primeros partidos.

WASHINGTON: The United States is expected to release details on the outcome of trade negotiations with China on Monday (Sep 28), US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said on Friday.
US President Donald Trump welcomed Chinese President Xi Jinping to the White House on Thursday but there was l ittle sign of a breakthrough on a host of sensitive issues.
"We're in a managed trade situation ... we've had progress, and we will release on Monday, I think, a lot more details about what we've accomplished over the past few weeks in negotiating with the Chinese," he told CNBC.
The US has agreed with China on exempting some key goods from arguments over trade, he said. The US would send agricultural products and medical devices "and we're getting from them, you know, consumer goods and other things that are non-sensitive", he added.

"We've actually reached agreement with the Chinese on a number of these things in areas where, you know if we have trade disputes in the future or if there are tariff measures in the future, we just leave those things to the side."
Greer also said that the current talks did not cover a small amount of high-quality US-made chips requiring licenses.
"These are the crown jewels of American technology. It's the way we stay ahead in the race for superintelligence, or AI, and so those conversations ... (are) not really happening in these negotiations," he said.
US Treasury Secretary Scott Bessent held talks with Chinese Vice Premier He Lifeng this week and said they had agreed to extend until Jan 10 a deal that paused a trade war that saw mutual tariffs top 100 per cent.

items.title: Trump sees no urgency for Canada deal as trade dispute deepens, USTR says
items.author: David Shepardson
items.creator: David Shepardson
items.summary: President Donald Trump's administration is comfortable maintaining its trade standoff with Canada even as new US import bans on Canadian products take effect next week and Washington threatens 50% tariffs on Canadian autos, parts and steel from January, US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said on Friday.
items.body:
President Donald Trump 's administration is comfortable maintaining its trade standoff with Canada even as new US import bans on Canadian products take effect next week and Washington threatens 50% tariffs on Canadian autos, parts and steel from January, US Trade Representative Jamieson Greer said on Friday.
His comments to CNBC signal Washington sees little need to compromise despite a deepening dispute that has strained relations between the longtime allies, triggered retaliation on both sides of the border and raised fresh questions about the future of the US-Mexico-Canada trade agreement.
The looming US import bans are on a broad range of Canadian goods, including alcoholic beverages, motorcycles and dairy products. The January increase on tariffs to 50% could carry significant consequences for North American auto production.
Canada's own retaliatory tariffs on US goods took effect earlier this month. Canadian tariffs followed 50% tariffs that the US imposed on some $20 billion of Canadian goods last month, after several rounds of negotiations collapsed.
"We're still getting what we need from them in terms of oil, gas, potash, all of these things. We're shipping (agricultural products) back and forth across the border, so there's still a lot of strong trade between the two countries," Greer told CNBC. "We're comfortable with where we are. ... They call us now and then, and we have good conversations about potential deals. But it's not – there's no urgency on our side, I would say."
The Canadian Embassy in Washington did not immediately comment.
The breakdown has widened a rift between the longtime allies, who have blamed each other for the failed talks, spurred Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney to urge a further shift away from Canada's biggest trading partner, and cast doubt on the viability of the US-Mexico-Canada Agreement.
Some experts think the Trump administration wants to first reach a deal with Mexico, which could give the US more leverage to get a better agreement with Canada. The next round of talks with Mexico could occur in October, Mexican officials said this week.

items.title: Dólar se encamina a su mejor racha en seis meses y estrategas prevén más ganancias hasta fin de año
items.author: Anya Andrianova, Naomi Tajitsu
items.summary: El dólar recupera terreno tras dos meses de caídas, apoyado por una Fed más restrictiva, la fortaleza de la economía estadounidense y su papel como refugio.
items.body: Bloomberg — El dólar se encamina hacia su mejor racha de dos semanas en seis meses, en un cambio de tendencia que probablemente respalde a la moneda durante el resto del año, según afirman gestores de activos y estrategas. En las últimas semanas, una conjunción de acontecimientos ha jugado a favor del dólar, a pesar de que un contexto de déficits públicos masivos, riesgo político y un Tesoro intervencionista sigue ensombreciendo sus perspectivas a largo plazo. El giro hacia una política monetaria más restrictiva de la Reserva Federal, la fortaleza continuada del auge de la inteligencia artificial y el aumento de las tensiones globales se han combinado para potenciar el atractivo del dólar. “Estados Unidos sigue siendo el lugar donde se produce el crecimiento de la inteligencia artificial; lidera el gasto en inversión de capital, y los márgenes y los beneficios empresariales son buenos”, afirmó Andreas Koenig, director de divisas globales de Amundi. “Así pues, esa dinámica sigue presente, lo cual es positivo para EE.UU. Existe el diferencial de tasas, que es positivo, por lo que resulta favorable para el dólar”. Ver más: Dólar avanza con su patrón alcista de finales de septiembre ante el tono restrictivo de la Fed El índice Bloomberg Dollar Spot ha subido alrededor de un 2% en las últimas dos semanas, alcanzando su nivel más alto desde julio, mientras que los precios de las opciones apuntan a nuevas subidas. Esto se debe a que los sólidos datos económicos de Estados Unidos anunciaron nuevas subidas de tasas de interés por parte de la Reserva Federal tras su primera subida en tres años e impulsaron los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro a nuevos máximos en varios años. Al mismo tiempo, el Nasdaq 100, con gran peso tecnológico, alcanzó un récord y los precios del petróleo reanudaron su avance. “Ahora vemos el riesgo de que la fortaleza del dólar continúe hasta finales de año”, afirmó Alex Cohen, estratega del Bank of America ( BAC ). Se trata de un cambio con respecto a la narrativa que ha prevalecido durante los dos últimos años, en los que los aranceles globales impulsaron los llamamientos a la desdolarización, mientras que la deuda pública estadounidense se disparaba hacia los US$40 billones, dando lugar a la denominada “operación de devaluación” —una reorientación hacia el oro u otros activos, ya que la laxitud de la disciplina fiscal está erosionando el valor del dinero y de los bonos del Estado—. Este cambio de enfoque ha llevado a Morgan Stanley ( MS ) a adoptar una postura alcista respecto a la moneda estadounidense, dando un giro a su previsión de larga data de que el dólar se debilitaría. “Pensábamos que el descenso del dólar continuaría hasta el segundo semestre de 2026. Nos equivocamos”, afirmaron los estrategas de divisas de Morgan Stanley, liderados por David Adams. “Las perspectivas del dólar son más optimistas, no más débiles”. Ver más: Dólar en octubre de 2026: a cuánto llegaría en Colombia, México, Brasil, Argentina, Chile y Perú, según analistas El índice del dólar ha subido un 1,6% en lo que va de septiembre, tras caer en julio y agosto, justo cuando los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro en todos los plazos se acercaban o superaban el 5%. La estacionalidad ha contribuido a ello, ya que la última semana completa de septiembre ha resultado ser la más fuerte para el dólar en la última década. Las subidas se produjeron incluso después de que el secretario del Tesoro, Scott Bessent, hubiera impulsado en los últimos meses las recompras de bonos en un intento por moderar los costes de financiación, al tiempo que respaldaba medidas para reforzar la moneda japonesa. Ambas medidas se interpretaron como negativas para el dólar. Para Daragh Maher, estratega senior de divisas de HSBC, la “relación ambigua” entre los rendimientos de los bonos del Tesoro y el dólar se mantendrá debido a los elevados déficits fiscales de EE.UU., lo que complica las perspectivas para la moneda. Koenig, de Amundi, está de acuerdo. “No creemos que el dólar vaya a dar un gran salto al alza”, declaró Maher a Bloomberg TV el jueves. “Se tratará de una modesta apreciación del dólar”. Ver más: Dólar sube 1,1% tras disiparse el temor a que Warsh no subiera las tasas pese a presión de Trump El giro hacia una política monetaria más restrictiva de la Fed pilló desprevenidos a muchos en el mercado. Los operadores especulativos, incluidos los gestores de activos y los agentes no comerciales, habían reducido drásticamente su postura positiva respecto al dólar de cara a la reunión sobre política monetaria, según la Comisión de Comercio de Futuros de Materias Primas. Los escépticos señalan la agresiva valoración de las tasas de interés por parte del mercado, que está poniendo el listón muy alto para la Fed. Los operadores prevén subidas de casi 90 puntos básicos en los próximos 12 meses. Según Nathan Thooft, gestor senior de carteras de Manulife Investment Management, a la Fed le resultará difícil ir más allá de eso, lo que frenará el repunte del dólar. “Si los próximos datos sobre la inflación, el mercado laboral o el crecimiento muestran signos de enfriamiento, la Fed podría tener margen para moderar parte de su discurso restrictivo”, afirmó Thooft. “En última instancia, eso podría limitar el potencial alcista del dólar”. Otras economías importantes también podrían tener dificultades para subir las tasas mucho más, ya que los precios del petróleo lastran el crecimiento. Ver más: Citi revela las razones del probable aumento en el precio del dólar 2026 tras decisión de la Fed El estratega de Citigroup Inc. ( C ), Daniel Tobon, señaló que el Banco Central Europeo podría llegar a un punto “en el que empiecen a producirse efectos negativos en cadena, lo que podría obligarles a dar marcha atrás en su política más adelante”, lo que dejaría al dólar en una mejor posición frente al euro. El mercado está descontando al menos una subida más del BCE este año. “En nuestra opinión, el riesgo de que surja nueva información se inclina más a favor del dólar que en su contra”, afirmó Tobón, quien desde enero mantenía una recomendación de posición corta en el euro frente al dólar. El euro ha perdido más del 3% frente al dólar este año. Tobón estima que el índice del dólar podría repuntar otro 1%. Otros indicadores también apuntan a una fortaleza de la moneda estadounidense, a pesar de que están surgiendo algunos indicios de que podría estar a punto de producirse una pausa. En el mercado de opciones, las denominadas “inversiones de riesgo” —una medida de la demanda alcista frente a la bajista— muestran que los operadores se decantan por el dólar en todos los plazos. El índice de fuerza relativa del indicador del dólar de Bloomberg —una medida del impulso— superó el jueves los 70 puntos por primera vez desde finales de junio, lo que apunta a que el repunte se está prolongando. El indicador RSI lleva subiendo desde el 9 de septiembre, lo que refleja una mejora en la confianza respecto al dólar. Según Maher, los riesgos geopolíticos contribuyen a reforzar este sentimiento, ya que han reafirmado el atractivo del dólar como valor refugio. “Cuando el mundo parece volver a desmoronarse —como hemos visto durante la última semana—, todos volvemos a refugiarnos en el dólar”, afirmó. “Así pues, la cuestión de la devaluación queda completamente relegada a un segundo plano. Algunas de las verdades indiscutibles de los mercados de divisas se mantienen firmes: el dólar es su valor refugio”. -Con la colaboración de Vassilis Karamanis. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

BAKU, Azerbaijan, Sept 25 : Runaway Formula One championship leader Kimi Antonelli called the mistake that put him out of qualifying for the Azerbaijan Grand Prix "stupid" and said it had brought him back down to earth.
The 20-year-old, who leads Mercedes teammate George Russell by 81 points in the overall standings after 14 rounds, clobbered the wall at the first corner in the opening phase of qualifying and had to park up with a broken suspension.
He will start 16th with Russell storming to a dominant pole.  
"I hit the wall and very unnecessary mistake so early on," the Italian told F1TV, explaining that he had simply misjudged the grip.

"It's a good way to come back to earth and to remind myself that I need to be on top of it every time because otherwise I do these mistakes and a very stupid one."
Antonelli came into the weekend gunning for his third straight win and ninth of the season so far. 
But a hydraulics issue during opening practice on Thursday cost the Italian valuable track time. 
He has trailed Russell, who has looked far more at ease around the 6km Baku street track, ever since.
Nevertheless, he is hoping the speed of the Mercedes can help him fight back.
"I'm looking forward to tomorrow," said Antonelli, who went from 19th to first at his home Italian Grand Prix in Monza. 
"Hopefully we can recover many places.
"The car is quick. Hopefully tomorrow is going to be a good race."

items.title: 米中貿易交渉の詳細、28日公表　ＵＳＴＲ代表「進展あった」
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary: [ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] -
items.body:
[ワシントン ２５日 ロイター] - グリア米通商代表部（ＵＳＴＲ）代表は２５日、中国との貿易交渉の結果に関する詳細を２８日に公表する見通しだと明らかにした。

グリア代表はＣＮＢＣとのインタビューで、「われわれは管理貿易の状況にある。進展はあった。ここ数週間の対中交渉で達成した内容について、２８日により詳細な情報を公表する予定だ」と述べた。

トランプ大統領は２４日、中国の習近平国家主席とホワイトハウスで首脳会談を行ったが、多くの懸案事項について具体的な打開策が示された兆候は限定的だった。

グリア代表は、米中が貿易摩擦の対象から一部の主要品目を除外することで合意したと述べた。米国からの農産物や医療機器の輸出、中国からの消費財や機密性の低い品目の輸入に言及し、「将来的に貿易紛争や関税措置が発生しても、これらの品目は対象外となる」と述べた。

一方、輸出にライセンスが必要な少量の高性能な米国製半導体については協議の対象となっていないと説明。「これらは米国技術の至宝であり、超知能や人工知能（ＡＩ）の開発競争で米国が優位を維持するための手段だ。だからこそ、これらに関する対話は今回の交渉では実際には行われていない」と語った。

ベセント財務長官は２３日、１１月１０日に期限を迎える米中間の「貿易休戦」について、両国が２カ月間延長することで合意したと明らかにした。より包括的な貿易協定に向けた協議の時間を確保することが目的としている。

items.title: ローマ教皇、国際対話は「茶番」を化す恐れ　国連は実効性の危機に直面と警告
items.author: ロイター
items.creator: ロイター
items.summary:
Joshua McElwee　Elizabeth Pineau

[パリ　２５日　ロイター] -
items.body:
Joshua McElwee　Elizabeth Pineau

[パリ　２５日　ロイター] - ローマ教皇レオ１４世は２５日、国連や他の多国間組織が危機に直面していると述べ、国際対話が「茶番」と化す恐れがあると警告した。国連教育科学文化機関（ユネスコ）のパリ本部で行った演説で語った。

教皇はこの日、４日間の日程でフランス入りした。演説では、特定の個人名を挙げることなく、法の支配を軽視する世界の指導者らを非難し、「権力者は、法を尊重する代わりに、自らの利益にかなう時にだけ法を持ち出し、自分たちの行動を制約する時には無視する。正義そのものをまるで売買するための商品のように扱っている」と述べた。

さらに、国連や他の多国間組織は「実効性の危機に直面している」とし、「対話は、平和のための資源ではなく行動の障害と見なされ、共に公益を追求する機会ではなく、茶番として扱われている」と語った。

２０２５年５月に初の米国出身教皇として就任したレオ１４世は、今年に入り、イラン戦争を批判してトランプ米大統領の怒りを買った。

items.title: Anvisa proíbe propaganda da caneta Semavy
items.author: Reuters
items.creator: Reuters
items.summary: A Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa) anunciou nesta sexta-feira que a Mantecorp, do grupo Hypera , não pode promover diretamente ao público a caneta de semaglutida Semavy, citando que a publicidade de medicamentos de tarja vermelha ou preta é proibida no Brasil.
items.body:
A Agência Nacional de Vigilância Sanitária (Anvisa) anunciou nesta sexta-feira que a Mantecorp, do grupo Hypera (HYPE3.SA) , não pode promover diretamente ao público a caneta de semaglutida Semavy, citando que a publicidade de medicamentos de tarja vermelha ou preta é proibida no Brasil.
"A Anvisa constatou a realização de propaganda do medicamento, por meio de painéis eletrônicos localizados no Aeroporto de Congonhas, no site do produto e em contas de redes sociais", afirmou a agência em comunicado à imprensa.
As ações da Hypera recuavam 0,6%, cotadas a R$24,47, às 11h06, enquanto o Ibovespa (.BVSP) tinha queda de 0,9%.
Segundo a Anvisa, a legislação apenas permite a propaganda de medicamentos que sejam isentos de prescrição médica, e a divulgação de drogas com tarja vermelha ou preta só pode ser feita a médicos, dentistas ou farmacêuticos.

items.title: BOLSA EUA Otimismo com IA ameniza preocupações com petróleo e rendimentos e Wall Street sobe
items.author: Johann Cherian, Avinash P
items.creator: Johann Cherian, Avinash P
items.summary: Os principais índices de Wall Street avançavam nesta sexta-feira, com o otimismo em relação à IA impulsionando o sentimento apesar dos preços elevados do petróleo e do aumento dos rendimentos dos Treasuries, enquanto os investidores acompanhavam os esforços para garantir um acordo que ponha fim ao conflito no Oriente Médio.
items.body:
Os principais índices de Wall Street avançavam nesta sexta-feira, com o otimismo em relação à IA impulsionando o sentimento apesar dos preços elevados do petróleo e do aumento dos rendimentos dos Treasuries, enquanto os investidores acompanhavam os esforços para garantir um acordo que ponha fim ao conflito no Oriente Médio.
As ações da Microsoft (MSFT.O) subiam 3% e davam o maior impulso ao S&P 500 depois que a gigante do software revelou vários novos recursos em seu aplicativo Copilot, incluindo uma ferramenta de programação e um agente de IA sempre ativo.
As fabricantes de chips Micron (MU.O) e Marvell Technology (MRVL.O) ganhavam cerca de 1% cada, enquanto a Nvidia (NVDA.O) registrava alta marginal.
O otimismo em relação à IA foi um fator importante nesta semana, impulsionado pelo Muse, da Meta (META.O) , e seu dispositivo integrado, o Charm, que vêm ganhando força entre os jovens consumidores. Alguns analistas apontaram isso como resultado dos fortes gastos com a tecnologia.
“A quantidade de dinheiro que está sendo injetada na economia por meio de investimentos em IA é simplesmente enorme, e ainda nem vimos a parte relacionada à produtividade”, disse Jamie Cox, sócio-gerente do Harris Financial Group. “O mercado está levando um pouco disso em consideração na avaliação, e essa é uma das razões pelas quais realmente não se vê uma grande liquidação.”
O Índice Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) subia 0,44%, para 51.576,71 pontos, enquanto o S&P 500 (.SPX) avançava 0,29%, para 7.726,62 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) tinha alta de 0,41%, para 27.048,75 pontos.
Oito dos 11 setores do S&P 500 registravam queda, mas isso era compensado por um ganho de 1% no setor de tecnologia (.SPLRCT) . Tanto o S&P 500 quanto o Nasdaq (.IXIC) estavam a caminho de registrarem altas semanais.
Uma notícia de que os negociadores dos EUA e do Irã continuavam a explorar um caminho gradual para sair do conflito, o que envolveria Teerã reabrindo o Estreito de Ormuz e Washington suspendendo seu bloqueio econômico, ajudava a melhorar o ânimo do mercado.
O otimismo, no entanto, era limitado pelas preocupações com a inflação, impulsionadas pelos conflitos prolongados no Irã e na Ucrânia e pelo aumento vertiginoso da dívida pública. Os preços do petróleo Brent oscilavam acima de US$ 100 por barril, e o rendimento do Treasury de 10 anos estavam em 5,1%.
Os operadores agora estimam uma probabilidade de 64% de que o Federal Reserve aumentará a taxa de juros em pelo menos 25 pontos-base em outubro, ante cerca de 50% mais cedo nesta semana, segundo a ferramenta FedWatch do CME Group.

WASHINGTON, Sept 25 : Kansas City Fed President Jeff Schmid said that as the artificial intelligence boom unfolds it will be important for the Fed to understand if the network of firms and contracts developing in the industry is becoming so large it is too big to fail.
"Where we have to start to really synthesize what's happening in the AI and the data center build-out is are we moving to a too-big-to-fail AI ecosystem," he said, referring to the need for public bailouts of major financial institutions during the 2007 to 2009 financial crisis because of their size and influence on the broader economy.
"You worry a little bit about how do we understand what's inside. ... Is there anything systemic?" he asked.

items.title: La mayor amenaza de la inteligencia artificial es biológica, no robótica
items.author: Gautam Mukunda
items.summary: Jacob Coxon, investigador de Anthropic PBC, renunció la semana pasada y publicó en redes sociales que su decisión se debía a que “quienes desarrollan la IA creen firmemente que podría acabar con todos ...
items.body: Jacob Coxon, investigador de Anthropic PBC, renunció la semana pasada y publicó en redes sociales que su decisión se debía a que “quienes desarrollan la IA creen firmemente que podría acabar con todos nosotros para finales de la década”. Evan Hubinger, líder del equipo de ciencia de alineación de la empresa de inteligencia artificial, estimó que la probabilidad de que esto ocurra en los próximos 10 años supera el 10%. El CEO de Anthropic, Dario Amodei, pidió una desaceleración en el desarrollo de la IA para mitigar los riesgos, una idea que compartieron el CEO de OpenAI, Sam Altman, y el CEO de xAI, Elon Musk. Quizás te estés imaginando el fin del mundo a manos de robots asesinos con marcado acento austriaco. Pero el mayor riesgo proviene de las células, no del acero. Una encuesta del Instituto para la Seguridad y la Tecnología, realizada a 111 profesionales de la seguridad nacional, reveló que el 70% cree que la IA aumenta significativamente —o pronto lo hará— el riesgo de las armas biológicas. Imagina a un investigador asistido por IA insertando un gen de señalización inmunitaria en un virus de la viruela que suprime la respuesta inmunitaria de forma tan completa que mata a todos los animales no vacunados que infecta y a la mayoría de los inmunizados. Eso es una pesadilla. Pero no es ciencia ficción. Ocurrió hace más de 25 años sin la ayuda de la IA. La viruela del ratón con el gen de la interleucina-4 tuvo precisamente ese efecto en los ratones, y se describió en un artículo publicado en el Journal of Virology en febrero de 2001. Los investigadores australianos que la crearon ni siquiera intentaban matar ratones; simplemente buscaban limitar su reproducción. El mundo natural proporciona a los aspirantes a terroristas una gran cantidad de patógenos. Si bien ya podemos agravarlos, aunque con cierta dificultad. La IA podría facilitar el proceso, pero nunca ha sido el principal obstáculo. Lo difícil era tomar el genoma de un virus (natural o modificado) y convertirlo en algo peligroso. Eso todavía requiere un laboratorio y científicos capacitados. Y las habilidades necesarias no se aprenden fácilmente en los libros de texto. Se trata de lo que se denomina “conocimiento tácito”, que durante mucho tiempo se ha creído que requiere experiencia y aprendizaje. En 1917, Francia solicitó a Estados Unidos la fabricación de réplicas de su cañón de campaña de 75 mm. Aun contando con los planos completos, Estados Unidos no logró producir ni una sola réplica en los 18 meses previos al fin de la guerra. Esto se debió a que los planos no describían las roscas del afuste, y al medir un cañón real, los estadounidenses encontraron seis tipos diferentes, ninguno de los cuales se utilizó en este caso. Como escribió el historiador militar H. A. De Weerd: “El único secreto del sistema de retroceso francés residía en la dificultad de su construcción”. Se trata de un conocimiento tácito. Con el tiempo, el conocimiento tácito suele perder importancia. Hoy en día, una fábrica podría fabricar armas a partir de archivos enviados por correo electrónico. Si bien el conocimiento tácito sigue siendo una importante medida de seguridad, este proceso apenas comienza en biología. Me preocupan sus efectos sobre el riesgo biológico desde mucho antes de que existiera la IA. En 2009, escribí un artículo con Kenneth Oye del MIT y Scott Mohr de la Universidad de Boston argumentando que la biología sintética era un intento de minimizar la importancia del conocimiento tácito en la bioingeniería y que podría aumentar las amenazas biológicas. La IA podría tener un impacto mucho mayor en la importancia del conocimiento tácito que el que jamás tuvo la biología sintética. El biólogo Roger Brent y Greg McKelvey Jr., de RAND, argumentan que deberíamos abandonar la suposición de que el conocimiento tácito es siquiera necesario. Demostraron que los modelos básicos disponibles en 2024 proporcionaban “instrucciones y orientación precisas para recuperar un poliovirus vivo a partir de una construcción creada con ADN sintético obtenido comercialmente”. Las empresas de capital de riesgo también están invirtiendo en “laboratorios automatizados” que podrían, al menos en teoría, eliminar gran parte del componente de habilidad humana en la biología experimental y aumentar rápidamente la velocidad a la que se pueden realizar experimentos. Esto es una excelente noticia para los defensores y para cualquiera que desee que la ciencia médica progrese más rápidamente. Pero sin salvaguardias, también podría ser una excelente noticia para los atacantes. Una medida de seguridad fundamental consiste en exigir que cualquier secuencia de ADN sintetizada se someta a pruebas para detectar su posible uso en un patógeno. Actualmente, la mayor parte del ADN sintetizado se compra a empresas, pero existen sintetizadores de ADN de sobremesa en el mercado. Muchas empresas de síntesis de ADN, aunque no todas, ya realizan estas pruebas, pero un equipo liderado por Microsoft Corp. demostró que las herramientas de diseño de proteínas basadas en IA ya pueden producir secuencias que el software de análisis no detecta, si bien no se ha demostrado que dichas secuencias sean eficaces. Actualmente, el gobierno federal solicita, pero no exige, la realización de pruebas de detección, y un marco revisado lleva 16 meses en el limbo desde que una orden ejecutiva lo solicitara. Debería exigirse la realización de pruebas de detección, y las empresas de análisis de ADN y los laboratorios de IA de vanguardia deberían aunar sus recursos para crear incentivos que recompensen a quienes superen las pruebas de ADN basadas en IA. Además, a medida que proliferen los laboratorios automatizados, estos solo deberían trabajar con investigadores verificados de instituciones de investigación acreditadas y estar sujetos a los mismos requisitos de pruebas de detección. Estas son políticas en las que no hay nada que perder. Serían una buena idea incluso sin IA, y son aún mejores con ella. Implementarlas sería mucho más fácil con ayuda federal. Desafortunadamente, en lugar de contribuir, la Casa Blanca se ha opuesto a la regulación de la IA, y el presidente Donald Trump ha declarado que “la IA dominando el mundo, destruyendo a la humanidad y todo lo demás malo, es un ENGAÑO” y que “el único control o ‘salvaguarda’ que necesita la IA es un PRESIDENTE FUERTE E INTELIGENTE (¡con un alto coeficiente intelectual!), ¡y Estados Unidos lo tiene de sobra!”. Por si acaso ese presidente de alto coeficiente intelectual necesitara asesoramiento experto, habría sido útil institucionalizarlo dentro del gobierno en lugar de disolver el Centro Nacional de Contraproliferación y Bioseguridad y la oficina de lucha contra las armas de destrucción masiva del Departamento de Seguridad Nacional . La administración incluso suspendió los marcos de control actualizados que habrían cerrado la laguna legal que permitía el paso de nuevos agentes. Hasta que el gobierno decida intervenir, los líderes del sector privado deberán suplir esta carencia. Anthropic ya ha denunciado el bloqueo de cinco intentos de utilizar a Claude para investigaciones que podrían contribuir al desarrollo de armas biológicas, y afirma que ya no puede asumir que sus modelos más recientes no alcancen el nivel necesario para ser de utilidad en su creación. Incluso un ataque menor con un agente biológico desarrollado con la ayuda de la IA seguramente conllevará una regulación que asfixie a la industria. Debemos asegurarnos de no acabar como aquellos ratones australianos. Esta nota no refleja necesariamente la opinión del consejo editorial de Bloomberg LP y sus propietarios. Lea más en Bloomberg.com

items.title: Air India suspends pilot involved in alcohol incident at Zurich airport
items.author: Deepak Patel
items.summary: The pilot was removed from operating the Zurich-Delhi flight after ground staff detected the smell of alcohol and will remain suspended pending an investigation ...
items.body: Air India has suspended the pilot who was removed from operating the Zurich-Delhi flight (AI151) at Switzerland’s Zurich airport on September 6 after ground-handling staff detected the odour of alcohol, sources said on Friday evening. The pilot  has been repatriated to India as a passenger, they added. The pilot was suspended after the preliminary breathalyser test came positive for alcohol beyond permissible limits. He will remain suspended pending the final medical examination report and completion of the probe, the sources said.  The September 6 incident was reported by The Economic Times on Friday. The Swiss Federal Office of Civil Aviation (FOCA) said it had informed the Directorate General of Civil Aviation (DGCA) about the incident, according to the report. Air India’s airport team had voluntarily identified and reported the issue to Zurich airport authorities before regulatory confirmation, sources told Business Standard. The airline has also issued a communication to all pilots reiterating its zero-tolerance policy towards prohibited substances and reporting for duty under the influence of alcohol or drugs. Disciplinary action in established cases can include termination of employment, depending on the nature and severity of the violation, said the sources cited above. This is the second recent incident where an Air India pilot has been found in violation of drug and alcohol rules. Air India flight AI2379, operating from Phuket to Delhi on August 4 suddenly lost altitude during cruise, injuring 20 passengers and four cabin crew members. Both pilots underwent mandatory drug screening after the incident, and the pilot-in-command's initial test was non-negative. A confirmatory test subsequently returned positive for marijuana. The Aircraft Accident Investigation Bureau (AAIB)'s preliminary report, released on September 4, recorded the non-negative confirmatory test and recommended that the DGCA should take action to prevent abuse of psychoactive substances. Air India terminated the pilot's employment with immediate effect on September 4. The head of flight operations has reinforced professional conduct and regulatory compliance among pilots, while senior flight operations and HR leaders are engaging with crew through weekly Crew Connect sessions, sources said on Friday. Fleet-specific engagement sessions have also been expanded to cover health, wellbeing, decision-making and professional responsibilities. The airline has strengthened compliance measures including mandatory testing for psychoactive substances in line with applicable requirements, enhanced awareness programmes, reinforcement of reporting obligations and continued monitoring of operational conduct. Zero tolerance policy The pilot was suspended after the testing positive for alcohol beyond permissible limits ahead of Zurich-Delhi flight on September 6He will remain suspended pending the final medical examination report and completion of the probeAir India’s airport team had voluntarily identified and reported the issue to Zurich airport authorities before regulatory confirmationThe airline has reiterated its zero-tolerance policy towards reporting for duty under the influence of alcohol or drugs

items.title: New York Yacht Club plots biennial women's international event
items.author: Alexander Smith
items.creator: Alexander Smith
items.summary: With a mix of Olympians, America's Cup sailors, national champions and amateurs, interest in the inaugural New York Yacht Club Women's International Championship last week was so strong that its organisers are already planning a follow-up in 2028.
items.body:
With a mix of Olympians, [USN:L8N45F18Y TEXT:"America's Cup"] sailors, national champions and amateurs, interest in the inaugural New York Yacht Club Women's International Championship last week was so strong that its organisers are already planning a follow-up in 2028.
"Having seen the success of this one, we're committed for 2028. We will definitely do it again," NYYC Commodore Clare Harrington said during the 20-team event, which ended in victory for a US crew skippered by Megan Grapengeter-Rudnick.
Harrington said the quality of the 200 skippers and sailors who committed to the event was impressive, citing New Zealand's Megan Thomson, who had just completed the [USN:L6N4520YB TEXT:"Ocean Race Atlantic"], as one example.
"She (Thomson) finished the race in Europe and then flew right back over here to get on the IC37. So it's really pretty cool," Harrington told Reuters in a video interview.
Thomson's team ended up 14th in the regatta, in which crews competed in the NYYC's fleet of identical IC37s, a 37-foot keelboat which the club describes as "a powerful, sporty platform that rewards cohesive crew work and athleticism".
For Harrington, who in 2025 was elected as the first female commodore in the NYYC's 182-year history, getting this year's women-only event onto the water in Newport, Rhode Island, was "kind of an experiment".
"We kept the entry fee at $5,000 for this championship because we just weren't sure how this was going to play out," Harrington said, adding that this compared with around $35,000 for the club's long-established Invitational Cup.
Financial backing was critical to staging the regatta, with the cost of sails alone totalling around $600,000, and NYYC was able to sign up major sponsors including State Street Investment Management SPY, Rolex and Helly Hansen.
NYYC also had what Harrington described as a "beautiful, spectacular" trophy specially made in Rhode Island by Tiffany.
Harrington said she was shocked and "beyond honoured" when she was made commodore.
"But I never at any point felt that I was appointed, nominated because I'm a woman," she said, adding: "I would never have accepted it if I thought that was the case".
"I didn't come out of thin air. I paid my dues. I've worked hard for the club for many years," she said, pointing out that she had for several years done "probably one of the most difficult jobs at the club" as chair of the race committee.
"I am the first woman, so I feel like there have been a lot of eyes on me," she added.

items.title: ハイパースケーラーAI投資、来年は5割増の1.2兆ドルに－ゴールドマン
items.author: Bloomberg
items.creator: Bloomberg
items.summary: （ブルームバーグ）：
items.body:
（ブルームバーグ）： 米国の大手ハイパースケーラー5社によるAIインフラへの支出は、来年に5割超増加し、1兆2000億ドル（約188兆円）に達する見通しだ。ゴールドマン・サックス・グループのストラテジストが明らかにした。

ライアン・ハモンド氏率いるチームはリポートで、この数字は2027年の設備投資についての市場予想1兆1000億ドルを上回ると指摘。各社が投資を回収するには、今後数年間に年間約3000億ドルのAI関連収入が必要になるとの見方を示した。

ハモンド氏らは「市場予想に基づくと、2027年の設備投資が国内総生産（GDP）に占める割合は、1800年代後半の鉄道建設以来、どの技術投資サイクルよりも高くなる見通しだ」と指摘した。

アマゾン・ドット・コム、アルファベット、マイクロソフト、オラクル、メタ・プラットフォームズの5社は今年、AI能力の拡充に8000億ドルを投じる見通しだ。来年の支出額は大幅に増えるものの、設備投資の拡大ペースは鈍化する見込みだと、ゴールドマンのチームは指摘した。

ストラテジストは「設備投資の伸び率と市場予想に対する上振れの度合いはいずれも、ここ数四半期に比べて低下する」と記した。ハイパースケーラーの設備投資は現在、営業キャッシュフローを上回っており、債券発行や株式による資金調達の必要性が高まっている。電力や労働力、メモリーの不足に加え、データセンター建設への規制が制約要因となる可能性がある。

ストラテジストは、ハイパースケーラーの設備投資の伸び率が今年の約100%から2027年には54%、2028年には12%に鈍化すると予想している。2028年の設備投資額は1兆4000億ドルに達する見通しだ。

ハイパースケーラーが十分な投資収益を確保し、アプリケーション事業者もコンピューティング費用に対して高い利益率を得るには、AI利用者がアプリケーションに年間約1兆ドルを支出する必要があると、ストラテジストらは指摘した。2026年の世界のソフトウエア支出は約1兆5000億ドルだった。

items.title: Putin's party sets new record in Russia election, United Russia wins 349 out of 450-member State Duma
items.author: Sayantani Biswas
items.summary: Russia's final election results give United Russia a record 349 seats in the State Duma, while 46 Ukraine war veterans enter parliament.
items.body:
Russia's ruling United Russia party has secured a record 349 seats in the 450-member State Duma, according to final results announced by the Central Election Commission on Friday, giving the Kremlin-backed party its largest parliamentary presence to date.The result exceeds United Russia's previous record of 343 seats, won in 2016, and follows Russia's first parliamentary election since President Vladimir Putin launched the full-scale invasion of Ukraine in 2022. Earlier preliminary results had put the party's tally at 355 seats before the final count was announced.Central Election Commission chair Ella Pamfilova said United Russia won 58% of the party-list vote and 209 of the 225 single-seat constituencies, bringing its final total to 349 seats.Russia State Duma election 2026: How many seats did each party win?The Communist Party emerged as the second-largest group with 37 seats, followed by the Liberal Democratic Party with 23, New People with 19 and A Just Russia with 17.The remaining four seats went to candidates who stood without a party affiliation.The election was held from 18 to 20 September across Russia's 450-seat lower house. Nearly 60% of the country's 111 million eligible voters took part, according to election authorities.The State Duma is elected through a mixed system, with 225 lawmakers chosen through party lists and another 225 through single-member constituencies.Russia election 2026: 46 Ukraine war veterans enter parliamentOne of the notable features of the new parliament is the number of Ukraine war veterans elected as lawmakers.Pamfilova said 46 veterans had won seats, including 41 representing United Russia. Putin has previously described veterans returning from the war as part of Russia's “new elite”.The Kremlin welcomed their election.“This is excellent. The experience of our heroes is in high demand. The results of the vote have clearly confirmed this,” Kremlin spokesman Dmitry Peskov told reporters on Friday.
“Each one of them will make the greatest possible contribution in whatever initiatives that they take on,” Peskov said.
Reuters reported that the Kremlin has highlighted the veterans' entry into parliament as part of a broader effort to bring former service members into political and public life.
Independent Russian media have reported allegations that several newly elected veteran lawmakers were accused of war crimes in Ukraine. Those allegations have not been established as convictions in the election results.
Why Russia's 2026 parliamentary election is significant
The vote was the first State Duma election since Russia's full-scale invasion of Ukraine. Voting also took place in Crimea and in four Ukrainian regions that Moscow claimed to have annexed in 2022. Kyiv has rejected Russia's authority to hold elections in those territories.The electoral environment has drawn international scrutiny. Parties and candidates critical of the Kremlin and its war policy faced restrictions, while the liberal Yabloko party was removed from the national party-list ballot by Russia's Supreme Court before the election.
Russia also did not invite election observers from the Organization for Security and Cooperation in Europe.
Ukrainian drone attacks overshadow Russia election
The parliamentary vote took place amid continued Ukrainian drone attacks on Russian territory.
Russian authorities said air defences intercepted more than 1,100 Ukrainian drones during the election period, including hundreds headed towards Moscow on the final day. Moscow Mayor Sergei Sobyanin described the attack as the largest ever against the capital.
Authorities said three people were killed and 38 injured in the wider Moscow region, while Pamfilova said six polling workers were killed and 75 polling stations were damaged or destroyed by shelling.The newly elected State Duma is scheduled to hold its first session on Wednesday, with Russian media reporting that Vyacheslav Volodin is expected to remain speaker.
